# Tinlance Agent Platform SDK

> Official Python developer SDK for building agents against the Tinlance Agent Platform's versioned, governed execution boundary. The SDK is a thin client contract layer; identity, tenant authority, authorization, policy, approvals, secrets, sandboxing, execution, and evidence authority remain in the Platform.

Use the links below to locate the authoritative source for each question. Prefer the contract and API documentation over inferred behavior.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, architecture boundary, supported Python versions, and public SDK surface.
- [Async example](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/examples/basic_async.py): Minimal asynchronous client example.

## API and contracts

- [SDK v1.0 contract](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/contracts/SDK-V1.0-CONTRACT.md): Public SDK contract for the current release.
- [Contract manifest](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/contracts/sdk-contract-manifest.json): Machine-readable operation and compatibility manifest.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/contracts/compatibility-matrix.json): Supported Platform/API compatibility information.
- [M21 program](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/M21.md): Enterprise developer-surface and certification program.
- [M12–M20 program](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/M12-M20.md): Contract governance, resilience, readiness, observability, credentials, and GA documentation.

## Architecture and security

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/README.md): Diátaxis-oriented navigation and repository documentation map.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting, security boundary, and supply-chain controls.
- [M0 transport hardening](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-platform-sdk/blob/main/docs/M0.md): Transport and response-validation acceptance gates.
